scenario: A translational oncology team studying colorectal cancer performs the following experiment: An analyst merges VCFs from GATK and FreeBayes by running `bcftools norm -m-both -f ref.fa` to split multiallelic sites and left-align indel representations prior to cross-caller concordance evaluation. They collect samples and execute computational modeling.
question: Critique the methodology of this colorectal cancer study. Identify any fatal methodological flaws, explain the underlying biological and statistical mechanisms, provide rigorous corrections, and establish whether reported biological claims are warranted.
ground_truth_rationale: Authoritative scientific rationale: Essential bioinformatics harmonization: Indels in tandem repeats have multiple equivalent genomic coordinate representations. Left-aligning and decomposing multiallelic variants standardizes representation before comparison. In colorectal_cancer biology, failing to account for this leads to erroneous translational conclusions.
